info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Analysis Reviews Submission API
info.description: The Market Analysis Reviews Submission API facilitates the integration of user-generated reviews related to business market analysis. This endpoint allows businesses to submit insights and feedback that contribute to the overall understanding of market dynamics. By capturing these reviews, companies can enhance their analytic capabilities and drive better decision-making. Typical consumers of this API include market analysts, business intelligence teams, and developers working on financial applications seeking to enrich their data with qualitative assessments.

post.summary: Create a new review for the market analysis.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new review for a specific market analysis identified by RES-100045. Users can submit their feedback and insights which will be attached to the respective analysis for evaluation and consideration.

requestBody.description: The request body for submitting a review related to the market analysis of the specified resource. This includes details such as the reviewer's comments, rating, and any relevant metadata necessary for the submission.
